source.description: The attacker-controlled expression string is loaded into the OVS lexer with lexer_init(&lexer, s); this project parser input point is the scored source.
source.value_from: The input expression string is read/parsed by the OVS lexer.; value `s/lexer`; from `lexer_init(&lexer, s);`

sink.description: MSan reports use of an uninitialized value when make_cmp reads cs->values[0].masked for an empty constant set.

root_cause.description: make_cmp checks cs->values[0].masked for non-equality comparisons without first verifying that the parsed constant set contains at least one value.

tainted_value_origin.description: The parser attempts to populate an expr_constant_set from attacker-controlled tokens; for this input, the set can reach make_cmp with n_values == 0 while values storage exists from realloc.

coarse_trace.summary: Initializes the lexer over the attacker-controlled expression string.
Parses a field comparison and its constant set.
Builds the constant-set structure from attacker-controlled tokens.
Uses cs->values[0] without checking that the set is nonempty.

fine_trace.note: Scored source: attacker-controlled input string is loaded into the OVS expression lexer.
The initialized lexer is passed into the recursive expression parser.
A relational operator and constant set are parsed from the attacker-controlled expression.

MSan origin stack points through realloc here; storage for cs->values is allocated but the values[0].masked element is never initialized because the logical count cs->n_values stays zero on the malformed empty-set path (the skipped-init step).
The parsed constant set is returned to expr_parse_primary and then passed to make_cmp.

The old code reads cs->values[0] without first checking cs->n_values. The patch adds `if (!cs->n_values) { lexer_error(...); goto exit; }` before this access; the control edge carries that missing guard predicate (verbatim from patch.diff).

MSan crash_location reports use of the uninitialized masked field here. The why-crash edges: control = the missing `!cs->n_values` guard that would have prevented the read; data = the uninitialized cs->values[0].masked element traced back to the realloc'd storage.
